text:
Evan: Hey team, flying into Chicago Loop on Tues for a quick meet. Looking for something near LaSalle/Monroe for 6:30pm  casual, group of 5, mix of meat/veg. Any recs?
Priya: For something fast and Chicago-y, Pequod's for deep-dish is iconic but can be slow.
Marco: Pequod's is heavy. If you want sushi, Kibo on Madison is walkable and has great veggie rolls.
Jules: There's a neat sandwich place, The Loop Deli, short lines and good GF bread option.
Rita: Also Big Bowl does bowls and is super quick if anyone wants lighter + gluten-free.
Evan: Poll: react :one: Deep-dish (Pequod's) :two: Sushi (Kibo) :three: Sandwich (Loop Deli) :four: Bowls (Big Bowl)
Priya: :one: (for the experience)
Marco: :two:
Jules: :three:
Rita: :four: (easy for travel)
Evan: Leaning sushi or bowls. Marco, can you check Kibo for Tue 6:30 for 5? If no, fallback to Big Bowl.
Marco: Calling Kibo now...
Marco: Kibo can do Tue 6:30, table for 5, Conf KIB-998. They noted one person with shellfish allergy  kitchen can accommodate.
Evan: Sweet, book it. Any veg/vegan options?
Marco: Yep they have several veg rolls and tofu entrees.
Jules: Can someone add to calendar? I'll be coming from the office and can meet there.
Rita: I'll add it and drop a reminder.
calendar-bot: Event added to #team-calendar  "Tue Chi Loop: Kibo Sushi 6:30pm".
Evan: Thanks all. If traffic looks bad I might Uber from the train.
lunch-bot: Note: street parking near Madison is limited after 6pm; rideshare recommended. :oncoming_taxi:
